body:
Independent review of W02's final correction packet at `5a32a86e124b657df4cf340592a6bdc8b2a61374` disclosed two additional exact targets in this existing source/category issue. Root checked the selected decision bytes, original JCM363 recipe capture and receipt hashes before routing corrections.

1. `W02-FC-D-10N-CASE-SCOPE`: individual cases114 and118 each repeat “all seven” in reasoning/applicability. Their frozen occurrence sets contain six and one respectively. The shared sulfuric-acid10N proposal correctly covers both cases and seven occurrences. Qualify each case with its own scope and label seven as the combined proposal scope; preserve all occurrence IDs and the correct shared payload, source normality, history and holds. Finding receipt SHA256 `e69bd8e23c9eff25bf247a0d827e13fce6c0ffde7adfd30d4b027d095b40bbbe`.

2. `W02-FC-D-SODIUM-RESAZURIN-TYPE`: `b2-proposal-sodium_resazurin_01_percent_wv_jcm363_1023` (cases88/93) remains `MINERAL_STOCK`. The actual JCM363 recipe lists 0.1% (w/v) resazurin-Na separately from its salt and carbonate stocks. Use `OTHER` for this named organic indicator preparation, with truthful appended history. Preserve its solute, unresolved component reference, 0.1 PERCENT_W_V, UNKNOWN closure, source applicability and release holds. Candidate SHA256 `8c43d59c4d4adcd07300804b29b219c2197328630bb6077adcc4fd95f8b3062d`; JCM363 capture `c4a470170f39aa1e9effd3eb70b7c9ac96b51a109fced58f4b1b305c368e72cc`; finding `3f62b7fa0c2cfd004568671f2ecc0168bfc567ab347315981f7924727454657c`.

Both finding receipts are in `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-02/final-corrections-v1/independent/`, named `new-finding-10n-case-scope-v1.json` and `new-finding-sodium-resazurin-type-v1.json`. Keep the sealed predecessor immutable; use a bounded guarded successor, focused preservation/negative checks and independent exact-byte re-review. These corrections confer no whole-owner, role or export approval and do not alter unrelated findings or source inputs.
